policy: A feature is production-ready only when CI proof, automated tests, staging proof, observability, real user-flow proof, and rollback/recovery proof are all present. Exposed production features without proof must fail verification.

features.name: Frontend Boot
features.notes: Frontend now renders a tested operations dashboard surface instead of a title-only shell. Real authenticated SaaS UI flows still require backend-connected Playwright and staging proof.

features.name: Frontend Product UX
features.notes: Operations dashboard, inventory control table, lead inbox state, scrape proof state, tenant/readiness signals, and invalid-VIN blocker visibility have automated frontend tests. This is not yet a backend-connected authenticated user flow.

features.name: Health, Readiness, Metrics, Version
features.notes: Modular and legacy health, readiness, metrics, and version route contracts exist. Live Render and staging proof still required.

features.name: Production Gates
features.notes: Build-time guardrails exist and now verify GitHub Actions workflows opt into the Node 24 JavaScript actions runtime, avoid deprecated Node 20 action major pins before GitHub's June 2, 2026 enforcement date, and keep Render Docker build filters tied to package-lock.json. Keep expanding gate checks as features are certified.

features.name: Render Staging Deploy Proof
features.notes: CI has a gated Render staging proof path that verifies health, readiness, and deployed commit when explicitly enabled. Render Docker build filters now include package-lock.json so deterministic dependency changes trigger service rebuilds. It remains disabled and not certified until GitHub variables are configured and the job runs green against the live Render staging service.

features.name: Authentication and Login
features.notes: Must not be called production-ready until session/JWT/reset/rate-limit/protected-route tests exist.

features.name: RBAC and Permissions
features.notes: Explicit SaaS permission matrix, permission/capability guard tests, tenant and super-admin user management plus dealership/settings route contracts, modular and legacy vehicle inventory-write route contracts, modular and legacy vehicle AI/scrape/Carfax/action route contracts, full inventory view read guard, dealership website-url, branding, and VDP footer tenant route contracts, financing/fee settings billing read/write route contracts, scrape-source and manual scraper diagnostic integrations read/write route contracts, email integration write and notification feed/audit read/write route contracts, call scoring, call analysis, and call participant read/write route contracts, CRM lead/message route contracts, appointment/follow-up lead route contracts, automation runtime and sequence-definition lead/message route contracts, automation Facebook lead trigger auth contracts, modular and legacy Facebook posting message read/write route contracts, FB inbox message/AI-control route contracts, legacy conversation message read/write route contracts, scheduled-message route contracts, messenger management/AI-control route contracts, Marketplace Blast account/template/queue/AI-generation/photo route contracts, manager VIN/pricing inventory-write route contracts, manager autopost queue read/write route contracts, manager notification email/outbox route contracts, external integration token route contracts, modular admin route contracts, super-admin scrape provider route contracts, super-admin impersonation, restart, ops dashboard, onboarding, and launch checklist route contracts, super-admin secret/API-key route contracts, super-admin Facebook Catalog and Facebook Marketplace route contracts, super-admin route guard regression coverage, super-admin filter group route contracts, and super-admin vehicle image upload route contracts exist. Full route migration, sensitive action audit proof, staging proof, and user-flow proof remain critical blockers.

features.name: Tenant Isolation
features.notes: Tenant context boundary has automated tests for header spoofing, legacy tokens, explicit super-admin selection, owner guard behavior, vehicle route tenant-context fail-closed behavior, dealership-scoped delete miss handling, dedup merge update/delete dealership scoping, scrape run update dealership scoping, Facebook page provider-id lookup/update token boundaries, legacy vehicle mutation dealership context, dealership website-url, branding, and VDP footer context, financing/fee settings dealership context, scrape-source and manual scraper sync dealership context, email integration and notification feed/audit dealership context, call scoring template/sheet/response dealership context, call analysis dealership context, call participant parent-record dealership context, AI runtime/settings dealership context, CRM lead/message route dealership context, appointment/follow-up route dealership context, automation runtime and sequence-definition route dealership context, automation Facebook lead trigger authenticated dealership context, FB inbox route dealership context, Marketplace Blast dealership context, manager VIN/pricing dealership context, manager autopost queue dealership context, manager notification email target-user dealership context, external integration token explicit dealership selection, super-admin vehicle image upload dealership-scoped selection/update, and legacy conversation/scheduled-message/messenger-management route dealership context. Full route/storage cross-tenant isolation across all resources remains a critical blocker.

features.name: Inventory CRUD
features.notes: Modular vehicle tenant/read-write route contracts, dealership-scoped delete miss handling tests, legacy vehicle mutation inventory-write route contracts, super-admin filter group inventory read/write route contracts, super-admin vehicle image upload inventory-write/tenant update contracts, scraped VIN active-storage guard tests, manual photo preservation merge tests, duplicate merge scoped update/delete tests, and dedup storage-schema mapping tests exist. Invalid scraped VINs are skipped before insert/merge, wrong-tenant/no-match vehicle deletes do not report success, duplicate merge writes/removals carry dealership scope, scraped facts map onto vehicle schema fields such as odometer/images/stock/color/VDP URL, incomplete new scrape records are skipped instead of inserted, and scraped photos cannot drop manually curated photos. Still needs complete CRUD behavior tests, duplicate VIN/stock tests, UI flow proof, staging proof, and broader source-truth overwrite protection.

features.name: VIN Validation Foundation
features.notes: VIN format/check-digit validation, model-year-aware NHTSA decode calls, tenant-scoped decode cache behavior, NHTSA 50-record batch boundaries, generated-CARFAX-link labeling, and provider disagreement metadata are covered by automated tests. Live provider staging proof, operational rate-limit monitoring, and real user-flow proof remain required.

features.name: Olympic Hyundai Scraper
features.notes: Extraction tests prove missing year/make/model source facts are not fabricated, extracted Olympic Hyundai facts map into the dedup storage contract, and scraper storage integration failures are returned as errors instead of hidden console-only warnings. Shared dedup storage tests now prove invalid scraped VINs are skipped before insert/merge, incomplete new scrape records do not become active inventory, scrape merge updates/deletes carry dealership scope, and scrape merges cannot drop manually curated inventory photos. Live pagination, source-truth reconciliation, quarantine tables/admin review, observability, and staging proof remain required.

features.name: Robust Scraper
features.notes: Compiles and fails closed. Robust scrape completion/failure updates require the recorded dealership boundary. Manual single-vehicle scrape diagnostics, manual scraper sync, and test badge routes require auth, explicit integration permissions, and dealership context; external scrape trigger routes are sensitive-limited and manual sync uses the resolved dealership instead of a body-selected dealership id. Super-admin Browserless, ZenRows, Zyte, Apify, and robust scrape provider status/test/trigger routes require explicit integration permissions. Not certified as a working scraper.

features.name: Facebook Marketplace Posting
features.notes: Modular and legacy Facebook Pages routes require explicit integrations read/write RBAC, including priority vehicle reads/writes, tenant-scoped provider page lookups, tenant-scoped token updates, and disconnect miss handling. Modular and legacy Facebook posting account/template/queue/schedule/OAuth/manual-post/config routes require messages read/write permissions and dealership context before storage. Facebook account, template, queue, AI generation, manual-post marker, photo, manager autopost queue, config, super-admin Facebook Catalog config/test/sync, super-admin Marketplace settings/account/queue/listing/activity/process routes, and salesperson-owned marketplace account/queue/listing routes require explicit permissions and dealership context before storage. Super-admin Marketplace auth/verify/process routes are sensitive-limited. Salesperson-owned marketplace account ownership checks include the resolved dealership. Marketplace posting must remain draft/human-approved until token, duplicate, image, posting, and failure tests exist.

features.name: AI Lead Response
features.notes: AI prompt management routes require explicit ai.configure RBAC and dealership context where dealership-scoped. AI runtime generation routes require explicit ai.use RBAC, AI settings and FB inbox auto-send controls require ai.configure RBAC, and public chat fails closed without dealership context. Still needs inventory-grounding, finance guardrail, prompt injection, escalation, human approval, observability, staging, and real user-flow proof.

features.name: GHL CRM Sync
features.notes: GHL/API-key integration routes now require explicit integrations read/write RBAC and dealership context, including dealership webhook-secret reads/regeneration and test email sends; GHL mutation routes are restricted to master users until write flows are certified. Still needs OAuth, token refresh, webhook verification, sync log, duplicate-contact, staging, observability, rollback, and real user-flow proof.

features.name: Billing and Plans
features.notes: Required for self-serve SaaS but not required for controlled pilot.
